smzdm-hot-trend 0.1.0 Changelog

- Initial release of the "什么值得买" 热门技能
- Supports information retrieval and summary of deals, discovery, and ranking pages
- Enables keyword-based deal highlights, category ranking statistics, and coupon/event extraction with time reminders
- Focused on organizing and reminding for public page content only; no order placement or automated scraping
- Includes common fields: title, price, discount type, brand, model, activity time, and source links
- Emphasizes compliance: no API reverse engineering or account operations, strictly internal analysis and reminders
